inheritance: All FDT8 field-feasibility ordering, JPN34 orientation coverage repair, state-aware module-function bridge v2, Japan7 colour stop rule, phyllary/stickiness histories and absolute-time constraints remain in force unless updated below.

jpn36_phyllary_access_pilot.active_operation: removable inert external collar/frame with blunt spacer tabs supporting outer phyllaries to a frozen natural-range access target
jpn36_phyllary_access_pilot.sham: same material, mass, visible profile, attachment positions and handling duration with spacer tabs flush and no phyllary displacement
joint_endpoints: legitimate visitor access and effective reproductive-structure contact
total, filled and viable achene output
blocking_gates: same-population observation-only natural reference and frozen access target
conservation review plus flowering-individual census and 2 percent population cap
stop_rule_summary: no randomization with an absent, expired or site-mismatched authorization
no cutting, removal, puncture, adhesive/coating or reproductive-tissue contact
remove the device and retain the assigned head in the integrity ledger after any injury/contact or more than 5 degree unintended orientation change
stop the batch if two of the first four assigned heads show device-attributable injury/contact
no outcome-informed device retuning, replacement, mediator expansion or underfilled efficacy rescue
jpn36_phyllary_access_pilot.next_gate: Complete non-manipulative reference/state confirmation and device qualification, then supply a deidentified site authorization record before deterministic allocation.
jpn36_phyllary_access_pilot.claim_boundary: Protocol readiness only. No site is currently authorized, no manipulation has been performed, and no safety, enemy, pollinator, reproductive, historical-mechanism or adaptation result is available.

do_not_repeat: Do not treat a protocol-schema pass as field permission or empirical execution.
Do not begin the randomized pilot without terminal collection and viability approval; otherwise the FDT8 joint endpoint chain is incomplete.
Do not replace the access proxy with phyllary cutting/removal or infer that the proxy recreates a historical natural state.
Do not use pilot nonsignificance as evidence of no phyllary effect or pilot direction as evidence of adaptation.
claim_boundary: Fail-closed execution readiness for the JPN36 pilot. It freezes what must be authorized, randomized, observed and stopped; it does not establish current site access, manipulation safety, causal function or adaptation.
